recipe.title: Dump-and-Go Crockpot Salsa Verde Chicken Bowls
recipe.summary: Tender salsa verde chicken with black beans, corn, cauliflower rice, and cool Greek yogurt for approximately 50 grams of protein and 370 calories per serving.
recipe.story: This is built for mornings when dinner needs to take care of itself. Everything for the chicken goes straight into the slow cooker, and the cauliflower rice and Greek yogurt are added when it is time to eat.
ingredients: 36 ounces raw boneless skinless chicken breast
1 (15-ounce) can black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In the morning, place the chicken breast in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Pour the salsa verde over the chicken, then add the drained black beans, drained corn, cumin, granulated garlic, onion powder, and salt. Do not stir the raw chicken with the other ingredients.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F and shreds easily.
At night, shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker and stir everything together.
Cook the frozen cauliflower rice according to its package directions.
Divide the cauliflower rice and salsa verde chicken mixture evenly among 6 bowls. Top each serving with an equal portion of Greek yogurt.
tips: Use refrigerated or freshly thawed chicken, never frozen chicken, for safe slow-cooker cooking.
Jarred salsa verde keeps the morning preparation under five minutes.
If your slow cooker runs hot, begin checking the chicken at 6 hours.
Divide both the chicken mixture and toppings evenly for the closest match to the listed nutrition.
Nutrition is approximate and varies by brand.
